answers.core: The main use case would be for tools to help users set up projects, downloading an additional add-on just to assist with that seems like overkill, plus the add-on would most likely be unused after setting up a project.
answers.workaround: It requires quite a bit of code to do a manual workaround, take a look at the methods [`open_asset_library()`](https://github.com/GodotVR/godot_openxr_vendors/blob/eadac11d90af84e530db3964446e2a3ffb2ef0e5/plugin/src/main/cpp/editor_plugin.cpp#L113), [`open_project_settings()`](https://github.com/GodotVR/godot_openxr_vendors/blob/eadac11d90af84e530db3964446e2a3ffb2ef0e5/plugin/src/main/cpp/editor_plugin.cpp#L176), and [`open_export_dialog()`](https://github.com/GodotVR/godot_openxr_vendors/blob/eadac11d90af84e530db3964446e2a3ffb2ef0e5/plugin/src/main/cpp/editor_plugin.cpp#L247) in the current implementation.

title: Add methods for easier access to project settings, export dialog, and asset library
